effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara starts AI assistance for generating technical questions.
effects.affects: It creates or requests AI-generated questionnaire content for the project when line items are available.
effects.leadsTo: Clara's question-generation panel or request state.
effects.check: With at least one line item, click Ask Clara and verify that an AI request or Clara panel appears.

effects.does: Clicking Add Attachments opens the attachment control for adding files.
effects.affects: It adds selected files to the event or questionnaire attachments.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments, select a file, and verify that the file appears as an attachment.

effects.does: Clicking Add T&Cs opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.affects: It changes the event's terms_and_conditions data.
effects.leadsTo: The terms and conditions drawer or dialog.
effects.check: Add a clause or attachment and verify that it is shown in the event's T&C section.

effects.does: Clicking Items 2 opens the event's two line items for review or editing.
effects.affects: It exposes the line-item records used by the technical stage.
effects.check: Click Items 2 and verify that two line items are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Save as draft saves the current project as a draft.
effects.affects: It creates or updates the event group and stores the current draft data without publishing the stages.
effects.leadsTo: The saved draft state, usually remaining on the creation screen.
effects.check: Enter a value, click Save as draft, reload the draft, and verify that the value remains and the event is still a draft.

effects.does: Clicking Publish validates and submits the project for publication.
effects.affects: It changes the event from creation into a published project or active event and can be blocked by missing title, participants, templates, or line items.
effects.leadsTo: Project details or the resulting published-event state.
effects.check: Complete the required fields, click Publish, and verify the success message and project-details navigation.

effects.does: Clicking Technical Stage opens or selects the technical-stage configuration.
effects.affects: It changes which stage's questionnaire and settings are being edited.
effects.leadsTo: The technical-stage configuration view or drawer.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that technical-stage fields and questions are shown.

effects.does: Clicking Test opens or selects the technical-question item labeled Test.
effects.affects: It changes the active questionnaire item being configured.
effects.check: Click Test and verify that the Test question's configuration is displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Satish Kumar Kaushik opens the control associated with that user.
effects.affects: It may change or display the selected project user or participant record.
effects.leadsTo: A user-selection menu or details popover.
effects.check: Click the named user and verify that a menu or user details popover appears.

effects.does: Clicking Long Text selects or adds a long-text question type.
effects.affects: It changes the questionnaire structure by adding or configuring a long-text response field.
effects.leadsTo: The long-text question editor or question row.
effects.check: Click Long Text and verify that a long-text question appears in the questionnaire.

effects.does: Clicking Invite Vendor opens the vendor invitation control.
effects.affects: It adds vendor participants to the event audience when vendors are selected and invited.
effects.leadsTo: The vendor invitation drawer or dialog.
effects.check: Click Invite Vendor, select an eligible vendor, and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Clicking Participants opens the participant management view.
effects.affects: It displays or changes the event's participant and audience records.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the current invited vendors are listed.

effects.does: Clicking Terms & Conditions opens the event's T&C management view.
effects.affects: It displays or changes the terms_and_conditions stored with the event.
effects.leadsTo: The terms and conditions drawer or dialog.
effects.check: Open Terms & Conditions and verify that the current clauses and attachments are shown.

effects.does: Clicking the displayed schedule opens the event scheduling control.
effects.affects: It changes the stage's start, end, duration, and related schedule data when saved.
effects.check: Open the schedule, change the duration, save it, and verify that the displayed ending time changes.

effects.does: Clicking the selected Technical Stage tab keeps the technical-stage view selected.
effects.affects: Nothing.
effects.check: Click the selected tab and verify that the technical-stage content remains visible.

effects.does: Clicking the RFQ tab switches the displayed stage to the RFQ stage.
effects.affects: It changes the currently edited stage and exposes that stage's configuration and questionnaire data.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that RFQ settings and questions replace the technical-stage content.

effects.does: Clicking the Satish Kumar Kaushik menu item opens its associated user menu or selection.
effects.affects: It may change or display the selected user record.
effects.leadsTo: A user menu or user details view.
effects.check: Click the menu item and verify that the associated user menu or details appear.

effects.does: Clicking Events navigates to the Events area.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the Events page loads.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Filling this field sets the project title.
effects.affects: It changes the event group's title used when saving or publishing the project.
effects.check: Enter a title, save or publish, and verify that the same title appears on the event.

effects.does: Filling Search users filters the available users by the entered text.
effects.affects: It changes only the visible user search results until a user is selected.
effects.check: Enter a distinctive user name and verify that matching users are shown.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Filling Search vendors you want to add filters vendors available for invitation.
effects.affects: It changes the visible vendor results and allows eligible vendors to be added as event participants.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with filtered vendor results.
effects.check: Search for a vendor and verify that matching eligible vendors appear while blocked vendors cannot be selected.

effects.does: Toggling Long Text Required marks the long-text response as required or optional.
effects.affects: It changes the validation requirement for that questionnaire question and can block submission when no response is provided.
effects.check: Turn the switch on, leave the response empty, and verify that the question is treated as required.

effects.does: This column displays the line-item number.
effects.affects: Nothing.
effects.check: Verify that each questionnaire row has a number in the # column.

effects.does: This column displays the required Specification field for each line item.
effects.affects: It identifies the specification value that vendors must evaluate or respond to.
effects.check: Verify that every line-item row shows its specification and that the field is marked required.

effects.does: This column displays the required Description field for each line item.
effects.affects: It identifies the description data included in the technical questionnaire.
effects.check: Verify that every line-item row shows a description and that the field is marked required.

effects.does: This column displays the required Vendor Response field.
effects.affects: It defines the response data vendors must provide for the technical question.
effects.check: Verify that the vendor-response column is present and that a vendor cannot complete the required question without responding.

cases.title: Reject publishing when the project title is empty
cases.expected: The event is not published. The message "Please fill project title!" appears.
cases.setup: Have at least one vendor participant and one line item configured. Leave the title empty.

cases.title: Reject publishing when no vendor is added
cases.expected: The event is not published. The message "Please add participants to proceed!" appears.
cases.setup: Enter a valid project title and leave the project without participants.
gaps: The catalog cannot explicitly clear or verify that the event audience is empty; omitting invite_vendor relies on the create screen starting with no valid participants.

cases.title: Show blocked vendors as unavailable during vendor search
steps: Open "Search vendors you want to add".
cases.expected: The blacklisted vendor appears disabled and is labeled "Blocked".
cases.setup: Have a blacklisted vendor available in the vendor search results.
gaps: The test does not name the blacklisted vendor, so the exact vendor cannot be searched or matched.
No catalog step can assert that the specific matching vendor search result is disabled; expect_disabled requires a known control name.

cases.title: Open the line-item details from Items 2
cases.expected: The line-item details view or panel opens and shows the two items with their specification, description, and vendor response columns.
cases.setup: Open the technical questionnaire screen with two items present.

cases.title: Open vendor invitation from Invite Vendor
cases.expected: The vendor invitation or participant-selection view opens, with "Search vendors you want to add" available.
cases.setup: Remain on the technical questionnaire screen.

cases.title: Open technical-stage configuration
cases.expected: The technical-stage configuration view or drawer opens for the current stage.
cases.setup: Remain on the selected Technical Stage tab.
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated assertion for the technical-stage configuration drawer or its complete configuration state; visibility of the Technical Stage view is used as the closest observable outcome.

cases.title: Block blacklisted and TNA vendors during vendor selection
steps: Open "Search vendors you want to add".
cases.expected: The blacklisted vendor is disabled and marked "Blocked". The TNA vendor is disabled and marked "TNA".
cases.setup: Have one blacklisted vendor and one TNA vendor available in the vendor search results.
gaps: Search for the specifically named blacklisted vendor because no vendor name is provided and no catalog step can perform a vendor search with an unknown value.
Search for the specifically named TNA vendor because no vendor name is provided and no catalog step can perform a vendor search with an unknown value.
Assert that each specific vendor result is disabled and associate the disabled state with the corresponding Blocked or TNA label.

cases.title: Disable the project title while adding a stage to an existing project
steps: Open the technical stage creation screen.
Inspect "Enter the title of the project".
cases.expected: "Enter the title of the project" is disabled while the new stage is being added to the existing project.
cases.setup: Open an existing project and start adding a new technical stage.
gaps: Directly open the technical-stage creation flow for an existing project without first creating a new version.

cases.title: Save the draft with the complete project payload
cases.expected: The request includes title, description, status, draft trade request UUIDs, audience company UUIDs, line items with status, UUID, quantity, product UUID, and product quality UUID, and a terms_and_conditions object with clauses and attachments.
cases.setup: Enter a project title, complete the required Specification, Description, and Vendor Response data, add a participant, and enable request inspection in the browser.
gaps: Set or verify a project description in the draft payload
Verify draft trade request UUID values specifically
Verify audience company UUID values specifically
Verify the line-item status, UUID, product UUID, and product quality UUID as exact nested fields and values
Create or verify a terms_and_conditions object containing clauses and attachments

cases.title: Open the item list from the item count
cases.expected: The item list or item details view opens and shows the two configured items.
cases.setup: Open the technical questionnaire with two configured items.
gaps: Directly assert that the opened item list or details view displays exactly two configured item rows.
